guideUpdate.title: Open GIS from the V4 launcher
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Opening GIS from the V4 launcher
steps: Select Open GIS on the GIS module card.
Wait for the GIS page and map to load.
Select the browser Back button to return to the launcher.
guideUpdate.reason: Document the verified navigation from the V4 launcher to GIS and back to the launcher.
